units.text: Do you import any of these products into the EU?
Do you import any quantity of hydrogen or electricity or more than 50 tonnes of the rest of the products in total per year?
Are you based in the EU, Norway or Iceland?
You are exempted and do not have to apply for CBAM authorisation. Imports will be monitored against the 50 tonnes threshold.
Do you have a CBAM account number?
An indirect customs representative with CBAM authorisation can take over your CBAM obligations.
Continue importing and monitor your embedded emissions.

Submit your application to the national competent authority where you are established. To declare your imports and apply for a CBAM authorisation, you will use the EORI number in the EU, the Norwegian organisation number/TIN (Organisasjonsnummer) in Norway, the Icelandic national identification number/ TIN (Kennitalais) in Iceland.

The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) puts a fair price on carbon emitted during the production of carbon-intensive goods that are entering the EU, Norway and Iceland and to encourage cleaner industrial production in non-EU countries. Find out more.
